domain: Mobile Game UI - Music Festival Tycoon

top_hud.pills: Fully rounded (borderRadius: 999), bg-black/60, 1px border border-white/10, blur background if possible. Icon left, white text right.

bottom_navigation.style: Dark solid bar, no transparency to ground the UI. Height 80px.
bottom_navigation.active_state: Neon tint applied to icon, subtle glow shadow.

build_drawer.style: Bottom sheet modal, takes up bottom 40% of screen. bg-[#141724]. Top corners rounded (24px).
build_drawer.cards: Squircle (16px radius). bg-[#1F2336]. 1px border. Shows programmatic 8-bit icon, Name, Cost (coin icon + num), Time (clock icon + num).

isometric_playfield.rendering_tip: Draw a diamond for the base. Draw sprites anchoring at the diamond's bottom center. No image assets - use programmatic SVG paths or skewed View blocks to form pseudo-3D 8-bit prisms.

construction_timer.style: Floating absolute badge above building center. Dark pill, neon text. Include tiny progress bar fill across the bottom edge of the pill.

simulation_results_modal.style: Full screen dark overlay. Central container with glowing borders.
simulation_results_modal.content: Top: 'FESTIVAL RESULTS'. Middle: Giant letter grade S-F. Bottom: 5 horizontal progress bars for (Stage Score, Crowd Flow, Vendor Coverage, Utility, Aesthetic).

motion.building_placement: Spring bounce scale (0.8 to 1.0) on drop.
motion.timer_tick: Subtle scale pulse on the final 5 seconds.
motion.results_reveal: Sequence: Bars fill up first (staggered), short pause, giant Letter Grade stamps in with a spring animation and heavy haptic feedback.
motion.button_press: Scale down to 0.95 on active press.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native Expo application. Use standard React Native View/Text components and StyleSheet (or NativeWind if configured) instead of Web DOM elements.
Files should be generated as .js files, NOT .tsx as per constraints.
No external images are allowed. All visual elements, including the isometric tiles and pseudo-3D building sprites, must be drawn programmatically. Use react-native-svg or standard skewed Views.
Maintain the Tycoon aesthetic (simcity/clash of clans) but apply the neon/night festival color palette provided.
Ensure all components have 'data-testid' mapped correctly for automated testing.
Apply 'prefers-reduced-motion' fallbacks if using advanced Reanimated/Animated sequences, though basic React Native Animated springs are acceptable.
